journal_lines: The passage opened into something vast and paper-smelling. Cannot read. Brought back a page anyway.
A library underground. Old shelves. Most of it rotted. Some of it wasn't.
Rows and rows of books in a sealed chamber. Took one that seemed different. Left the rest.
A library lit by something I could not find the source of. Did not look for the source long.
Brought back a book whose cover was warm to the touch. Set it down carefully when I got home.
The shelves were taller than the doorways were wide. Tried not to think about it.
Air thick with the smell of old binding glue and a hundred quiet years.
Books in a language only the wind seemed to know. The wind was elsewhere.
